Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly hypothesized that Zaheer was introduced in Season 2 (Book Two: Spirits) and became the main antagonist in Season 3. While Zaheer does appear in Season 2 (specifically in the finale episode "The Battle of the Spirits"), he is not introduced there; his canonical introduction as a named character and main antagonist occurs in Season 3 ("A Breath of Fresh Air"). The Planner failed to verify this distinction in the first step, leading the entire search process to focus on confirming a false premise (that he was introduced in Season 2) rather than establishing the correct timeline. This error persisted through subsequent steps, causing the agents to search for conflicting information about his Season 2 appearance instead of simply confirming his Season 3 introduction.
